title: review-checklist.md line 33 quotes the same stale three-tier read order — the second site of the drift found while correcting rest-channel.md
body:
Found while landing the `rest-channel.md` header correction (issue 13008), which asked in
its own body whether any other file quotes the read order and drifted the same way. It
does. Filed unassigned and **not** fixed in that PR — see "Why it was not folded in" below.

## The drift

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` line 33 carries:

```text
- **报告 `tests`/证据里有 git 本可回答的 API 读吗?**(dev 契约的读序是 git → REST →
  MCP/GraphQL)判据:MCP `list_issues`/`search_issues` 一类 GraphQL 读,或重跑派发词已下发的去重读数
```

Three tiers, and the zero-quota payload tier is missing — the same omission, in the same
direction, as the header just corrected in `rest-channel.md`.

## Why it was not folded into that PR

The bounded in-place fix exemption in the dev contract needs all four of its conditions.
Condition 2 — the correct form is pinned by existing evidence — does **not** hold here,
and that is the whole reason this is a separate card rather than a one-word insertion:

- `rest-channel.md`'s header **names its source** (`platform-readings.md`) and quotes that
  file's policy line, so the correction was a mechanical copy of a spelling that already
  exists on disk.
- This line names a **different** source: 「dev 契约的读序」 — the dev contract, which is
  `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`. That file does not state a compact ordered ladder in the
  `git → X → Y` spelling at all; it states the discipline as prose (probe repo-scoped REST
  first, take the zero-quota payload channel for bulk reads, keep MCP for writes plus the
  one dedupe search). So what the corrected spelling should be is a judgement about how to
  summarise that prose as a ladder, not a copy of an existing one.

Deciding that inside a PR claimed for one file, on a second zero-headroom governed surface,
is exactly the unreviewable scope creep the exemption exists to prevent.

## Constraint on whoever takes it

- `review-checklist.md` is governed and ratcheted at **84 lines, ceiling 84, headroom 0** —
  so net 0 lines.
- Good news on the byte budget, measured rather than assumed: line 33 is **105 bytes**
  against the 120-byte cap. The insertion that the sibling card needed costs **12 bytes**,
  which would land it at **117** — under the cap, so unlike the sibling this one very likely
  needs **no re-wrap at all**. Re-measure before writing; the arithmetic above is this
  seat's, not a gate's.
- The real work is the judgement in the section above, not the edit.

## The general gap, worth its own consideration

Nothing mechanically holds a quoted policy equal to its source across these files. Both
sites were found by reading, not by a gate, and the second one only because the first card's
body thought to ask. A third site can appear the same way and stay wrong indefinitely. There
may be a cheap gate here — a pinned pairing of "this file quotes that file's ladder" — but
that is a design question, not part of this fix.
